en.does_not_prove: It does not show who changed the body, when, or why: forwarding systems, mailing lists, antivirus footers and re-encoding by a mail client also change bodies after signing.
en.shows: The DKIM signature of example.org (selector s2026) records a hash of the message body that differs from the hash of the body as it is now: the body is not the one that was signed.
en.title: DKIM body hash does not match

en.next_step: Do not rely on this file until the examiner has explained the problem.
en.summary: The file could not be fully examined or shows a serious problem.
